subject: French

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Develop phonemic awareness and the pronunciation of French letters
activities.learning_activity: (a) Listen to and identify French sounds
suggested_methods: Repetition: Have students listen to French sounds and repeat them aloud.
Sound discrimination game: Have students play this game using minimal pairs carrying targeted sounds.
Ball game: Using a ball, have students play this game by pronouncing the targeted sounds
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to identify French sounds
suggested_resources: - Simple oral documents carrying targeted sounds

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Develop phonemic awareness and the pronunciation of French letters
activities.learning_activity: (b) Pronounce the sounds of French letters
suggested_methods: Repetition: Have students listen to and repeat the sounds of the letters worked on
Reading aloud: Lead students to read French letters aloud
Ball game: Have students play the ball game while pronouncing the targeted letter sounds
Tongue twisters: Have students repeat simple tongue twisters carrying the targeted letter sounds
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly pronounce French sounds

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Develop phonemic awareness and the pronunciation of French letters
activities.learning_activity: (c) Combine the sounds of French letters to form words
suggested_methods: Brainstorming: Lead students to think about the French letter sounds they already know and use these sounds to form simple words
Song: Lead students to sing the French alphabet song
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to combine French letter sounds to form French words

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Relate words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (a) Recognize the names of classroom objects presented orally and in writing
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Show students real objects or pictures of classroom objects, then ask them to name them (Example: Question - What is this? Answer - It is a ...)
Guessing game: Lead students to listen to descriptions of classroom objects and identify their names
Project: Organize students to draw and name/label classroom objects in French
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to identify the names of classroom objects presented orally and in writing
suggested_resources: - Photos/drawings of objects in the immediate environment

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Relate words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (b) Recognize the names of animals and objects in the immediate environment presented orally and in writing
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Show students real objects or pictures of objects/animals, and then ask them to name them (Example: Question - What is this? Answer - It is a ...)
Guessing game: Have students listen to descriptions of animals and objects in the immediate environment and identify their names
Project: Organize students to draw and name/label in French pictures of animals and real objects from the immediate environment
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to recognize the names of animals and objects in the immediate environment presented orally and in writing
suggested_resources: - Real objects from the immediate environment
- Photos/drawings of animals/objects in the immediate environment

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Relate words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (c) Recognize the names of family members presented orally and in writing
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Show students photos/drawings of a family member, and then ask them to name them (Example: Question - Who is this? Answer - It is the ...)
Project: Organize students to draw and name/label family members
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to identify family members presented orally and in writing
suggested_resources: - Audio or written documents featuring family members

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Relate words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (d) Use numbers up to 20 orally and in writing
suggested_methods: Song: Lead students to sing a song about numbers up to 20
Practical work: Guide students to arrange objects according to numbers

Questions and answers: Show students real objects or their pictures, and then ask them to give the number of the presented objects (Example: Question - How many ... are there on the table? Answer - There are ... on the table)
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use numbers up to 20 orally and in writing
suggested_resources: - Audio documents/songs featuring numbers up to 20
- Photos/drawings of objects in the immediate environment

activities.specific_competence: 1.3 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use simple grammar and vocabulary orally and in writing to locate objects in the immediate environment (at school, at home)
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Show students where real objects or their pictures are located, and then ask them to locate these objects (Example: Question - Where is ...? Answer - He/she/it is ...)
Practical work: Have students listen to an audio document on location to identify the objects in question
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use simple grammar and vocabulary orally and in writing to locate objects in the immediate environment (at school, at home)

activities.specific_competence: 1.3 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (b) Use simple grammar and vocabulary orally and in writing to introduce oneself and introduce someone else
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Demonstrate to students how to introduce oneself and ask them to introduce themselves in turn
Questions and answers: Lead students to introduce themselves using questions (Example: Question - What is your name? How old are you? Where do you live? Answer - My name is ..., I am ..., I live ...)
Role play: Guide students in pairs to play the role of introducing someone else
Practical work: Have students listen to an audio document on self-introduction to identify personal information
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use simple grammar and vocabulary orally and in writing to introduce oneself and introduce someone else

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate understanding of spoken and written information
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Read and understand simple texts
activities.learning_activity: (a) Read and understand short messages (announcements, instructions, text messages)
suggested_methods: Presentation: Guide students to read simple texts and present what they have understood
Questions and answers: Guide students to read simple and short texts, then ask them questions to check comprehension
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to read and understand simple and short texts (announcements, instructions, and text messages)
suggested_resources: - Simple authentic texts (announcements, instructions, and text messages)

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate understanding of spoken and written information
activities.specific_competence: 2.2 React appropriately to a familiar communication context
activities.learning_activity: (a) Follow simple instructions given orally and in writing in a familiar context (at school and at home)
suggested_methods: Role play: Guide students to play teacher-student/student-student/parent-child roles, etc.
Dramatization: Lead students to react based on read messages
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to react appropriately based on messages communicated in announcements, text messages, and instructions given at school and at home

activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Demonstrate knowledge of the basic characteristics of spoken and written language
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use appropriate intonations in simple communication
suggested_methods: Dialogue game: Guide students to engage in dialogue taking into account correct intonation
Practical work: Guide students to formulate questions using intonation
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use correct intonations in communication

activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Demonstrate knowledge of the basic characteristics of spoken and written language
activities.learning_activity: (b) Use punctuation marks (capital letter, lowercase letter, period, and question mark) in simple texts
suggested_methods: Writing workshop: Guide students to write sentences and short texts using punctuation marks
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly use capital letters, lowercase letters, periods, and question marks in simple texts

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Link words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (a) Recognize the names of human body parts presented orally and in writing
suggested_methods: Song/rhyme: Lead students to sing a song/rhyme about the parts of the human body
Role play: Guide students to play a role related to body parts (at the doctor)
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to recognize the names of human body parts presented orally and in writing

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Link words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (b) Use numbers up to 60 orally and in writing
suggested_methods: Song: Lead students to sing a song of numbers up to 60
Practical work: Guide students to associate object images according to numbers
Questions and answers: Show students the images, and then ask them to state the numbers (Example: Question - How many ... are there in the basket? Answer - There are ... in the basket.
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use numbers up to 60 correctly orally and in writing
suggested_resources: - Audio documents/songs about numbers up to 60

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use simple grammar and vocabulary to describe people orally and in writing
suggested_methods: Project: Guide students to draw and describe people
Guessing game: Guide students to play a guessing game to describe people
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to describe people physically and morally orally and in writing using simple grammar and vocabulary
suggested_resources: - Oral documents on the description of people
- Audio-visual documents on the description of people
- Photos/drawings on the description of people

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (b) Use simple grammar and vocabulary to describe objects orally and in writing
suggested_methods: Project: Guide students to draw and describe objects familiar to them
Guessing game: Guide students to play a guessing game to describe objects
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to describe objects orally and in writing
suggested_resources: - Oral documents on the description of objects
- Audio-visual documents on the description of objects
- Photos/drawings on the description of objects

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (c) Use simple grammar and vocabulary to describe places/locations orally and in writing
suggested_methods: Project: Guide students to draw maps of their neighborhood, village, street and describe them
Writing workshop: Lead students to write simple texts to describe places/locations
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly describe different places/locations

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (d) Use simple grammar and vocabulary orally and in writing to express the days of the week and the months of the year
suggested_methods: Songs/rhymes: Lead students to sing a song/rhyme to learn the days of the week and/or the months of the year
Memory game: Prepare a game about the days of the week or the months of the year, and then guide students to play this game
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly state the days of the week and the months of the year using simple grammar and vocabulary

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (e) Use simple grammar and vocabulary to ask for and tell the time
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Lead students in pairs to ask each other and tell the time (Example: Question - What time is it? Answer - It is ... hour(s))
Project: Guide students to prepare their daily schedule
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to ask for and tell the time correctly using simple grammar and vocabulary

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (f) Ask for and state the date
suggested_methods: Role play: Lead students in pairs to ask each other and state the date (Example: Question - What is the date today? Answer - Today is the ...)
Project: Guide students to prepare their weekend program
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to ask for and state the date correctly

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate comprehension of spoken and written information
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Listen to and understand simple information
activities.learning_activity: (a) Listen to and understand information about likes and preferences
suggested_methods: Presentation: Guide students to listen to and present information about likes and preferences
Dialogue game: Guide students to assign roles and state what they like or do not like
Song: Guide students to sing a song about likes or preferences
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to listen to and understand information about likes and preferences

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate comprehension of spoken and written information
activities.specific_competence: 2.2 Read and understand simple texts
activities.learning_activity: (a) Read and understand simple descriptions of people, objects, and animals
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Guide students to read simple texts on descriptions of people, objects, and animals, and then ask them questions to check comprehension
Presentation: Guide students to read simple texts on descriptions of people, objects, and animals and present important information
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to read and understand simple descriptions of people, objects, and animals
suggested_resources: - Photos/drawings of people, objects, and animals

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate comprehension of spoken and written information
activities.specific_competence: 2.3 Respond appropriately to a familiar communication context
activities.learning_activity: (a) Follow traffic rules and instructions
suggested_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to reflect on the traffic rules present in their surroundings
Project: Guide students to draw and label road signs
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly follow traffic rules and instructions
suggested_resources: - Simple authentic texts on traffic rules/road signs

activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Demonstrate knowledge of basic features of spoken and written language
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use punctuation marks (exclamation marks and commas) in simple texts
suggested_methods: Writing workshop: Guide students to write sentences and short texts using punctuation marks
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly use punctuation marks (exclamation marks and commas) in simple texts

activities.specific_competence: 3.2 Converse in various contexts using appropriate grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary to express feelings
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Guide students in pairs to ask each other questions based on the expression of feelings and answer them
Role play: Guide students to play roles in various communication contexts
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use appropriate grammar and vocabulary to express feelings

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Match words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use numbers up to 500 orally and in writing
suggested_methods: Role-play: Guide students to play roles using numbers up to 500
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use numbers up to 500 orally and in writing
suggested_resources: Oral documents on numbers up to 500
Audio-visual documents on numbers up to 500
Simple authentic texts on numbers up to 500

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use simple grammar and vocabulary orally and in writing to ask for and give directions
suggested_methods: Practical work: Make students listen to a short, simple audio document about street directions
Dialogue game: Guide students in pairs to play a short dialogue about directions
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use simple grammar and vocabulary orally and in writing to ask for and give directions appropriately
suggested_resources: Oral documents on asking for directions
Audio-visual documents on asking for directions
Authentic texts on asking for directions

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (b) Use simple grammar and vocabulary orally and in writing to make and respond to a polite request
suggested_methods: Dialogue game: Guide students in pairs to play a short dialogue to make and respond to a polite request
Team game (crossword puzzle): Lead students in teams to play this game based on grammar and vocabulary related to polite requests
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use simple grammar and vocabulary orally and in writing to make and respond to a polite request appropriately
suggested_resources: Oral documents on a polite request
Audio-visual documents on a polite request
Authentic texts on a polite request

activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (c) Use simple grammar and vocabulary orally and in writing to talk about daily routines
suggested_methods: Dialogue game: Guide students in pairs to play a short dialogue to talk about daily routines

Memory game: Lead students to play this game on the subject of talking about their daily routine (Example - I get up in the morning and brush my teeth, I get up in the morning, brush my teeth and take a bath, ...)
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use simple grammar and vocabulary orally and in writing to talk correctly about daily routines
suggested_resources: Audio documents on expressing daily routines
Audio-visual documents on expressing daily routines
Written texts on expressing daily routines

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate comprehension of spoken and written information
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Listen to and understand simple information
activities.learning_activity: (a) Listen to and understand information on means of transport
suggested_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to think about and identify different means of transport
Questions and answers: Using questions, guide students to identify means of transport
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly understand information on means of transport
suggested_resources: Authentic texts on means of transport/images
Oral/audio-visual documents on means of transport

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate comprehension of spoken and written information
activities.specific_competence: 2.2 Read and understand simple texts
activities.learning_activity: (a) Read and understand short stories
suggested_methods: Presentation: Guide students to read short stories for comprehension, and then make a presentation on the message of the story
Discussion: Guide students in small groups to read a short narrative text and discuss it
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to read and understand short stories

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate comprehension of spoken and written information
activities.specific_competence: 2.3 Read simple texts correctly
activities.learning_activity: (a) Read simple texts with fluency
suggested_methods: Reading aloud: Guide students to read simple texts aloud taking into account good pronunciation, rhythm, intonation, and appropriate speed
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to read simple texts with fluency

activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Demonstrate knowledge of basic characteristics of spoken and written language
activities.learning_activity: (a) Make a phone call to someone
suggested_methods: Dialogue/role-play game: Guide students in pairs to converse on telephone conversations about familiar topics
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to converse on the telephone appropriately
suggested_resources: Short oral/audio-visual documents on telephone conversations

activities.specific_competence: 3.2 Converse in varied contexts using appropriate grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use simple grammar and vocabulary to ask for and give prices
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Ask students questions about the prices of various objects
Role-play: Guide students to play the roles of customer/vendor
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to ask for and give prices appropriately

activities.specific_competence: 3.2 Converse in varied contexts using appropriate grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (b) Use simple grammar and vocabulary to have a simple conversation about food items
suggested_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to think about various food items
Role-play: Guide students to play roles in a conversation about food items
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use simple grammar and vocabulary to have a simple conversation about food items
suggested_resources: Oral/audio-visual documents on the topic of food items
Various written texts on food items

activities.specific_competence: 3.3 Communicate in writing in varied contexts using appropriate grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary to correspond (write postcards and invitation cards)
suggested_methods: Presentation: Guide students to write postcards or invitation cards, and then present them
Writing workshop: Guide students in manageable groups to write postcards or invitation cards
activities.assessment_criteria: Abilities to write a postcard or invitation card correctly

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Master basic language skills in French
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Relate words to objects in the environment
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use numbers up to 1,000 orally and in writing
suggested_methods: Role play: Guide students to play roles using numbers up to 1,000
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to use numbers up to 1,000 orally and in writing
suggested_resources: Oral documents on numbers up to 1,000
Audio-visual documents on numbers up to 1,000
Simple authentic texts on numbers up to 1,000

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Master basic language skills in French
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use simple grammar and vocabulary to narrate a past event (holidays, trips)
suggested_methods: Songs/stories/rhymes: Guide students to sing or narrate past events about holidays or trips
Presentation: Guide students to use simple grammar and vocabulary to narrate a past event about holidays or trips
Writing workshop: Guide students to write narrative texts about holidays or trips
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly use simple grammar and vocabulary to narrate past events about holidays or trips
suggested_resources: Authentic oral/audio-visual documents on narrations of past events

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Master basic language skills in French
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (b) Use simple grammar and vocabulary to express future events
suggested_methods: Presentation: Guide students to use simple grammar and vocabulary to express future events
Writing workshop: Guide students to use simple grammar and vocabulary to write simple texts about future events
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly use simple grammar and vocabulary to express future events
suggested_resources: Authentic oral/audio-visual documents on narrations of future events
Simple written texts on narrations of future events

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Master basic language skills in French
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Master simple grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (c) Use simple grammar and vocabulary to talk about daily activities
suggested_methods: Presentation: Guide students to use simple grammar and vocabulary to talk about daily activities
Dialogue game: Guide students to use simple grammar and vocabulary to dialogue about daily activities
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly use simple grammar and vocabulary to talk about daily activities
suggested_resources: Authentic oral/audio-visual documents on information about daily life

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate understanding of oral and written information
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Listen to and understand simple information
activities.learning_activity: (a) Listen to and understand weather information
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Guide students to listen to an oral document on the weather, and then ask them questions to check comprehension
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly listen to and understand weather information
suggested_resources: Authentic oral/audio-visual documents on the weather

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate understanding of oral and written information
activities.specific_competence: 2.2 Read and understand simple texts
activities.learning_activity: (a) Read and understand simple poems
suggested_methods: Questions and answers: Guide students to read simple poems, then ask them questions to check comprehension
Presentation: Guide students in manageable groups to read simple poems, and then present the message
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly read and understand poems

activities.specific_competence: 3.3 Communicate in writing in various contexts using appropriate grammar and vocabulary
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use appropriate grammar and vocabulary to write a short friendly letter
suggested_methods: Presentation: Guide students to write short friendly letters, and then present them
activities.assessment_criteria: Ability to correctly write a short friendly letter
